channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: Officials say perpetrators identified in border flag attack
item.description: Turkish defense officials said on Jan. 22 that authorities have identified the individuals responsible for removing a Turkish flag at the Syrian border, an incident they characterized as an "organized provocation."

item.title: Gentleman of the stage: Haldun Dormen
item.description: A pioneering force in Western-style theater and musicals in Türkiye, master actor, director and educator Haldun Dormen, who shaped generations of performers through the Dormen Theater and his landmark productions, died in Istanbul at the age of 97

item.title: Türkiye apprehends 478 irregular migrants in nationwide checks
item.description: Turkish authorities have detained 19 suspected migrant smuggling organizers and apprehended 478 irregular migrants during nationwide inspections carried out across all of the country’s 81 provinces, Interior Minister Ali Yerlikaya announced on Jan. 22.

item.title: Preliminary report finds Libyan jet hit hillside at high speed
item.description: Türkiye has completed a preliminary investigation report into the aircraft crash that killed a Libyan military delegation late last year, concluding that the jet slammed at high speed into a hillside while its engines were still running.

item.title: US envoy says Ukraine-Russia talks 'down to one issue'
item.description: Talks to end the war in Ukraine have made "a lot of progress" and are "down to one issue" between Kiev and Moscow, U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff said on Thursday ahead of a trip to Russia.

item.title: Central Bank cuts policy rate by 100 bps to 37 percent
item.description: Türkiye’s Central Bank on Jan. 22 lowered its benchmark one-week repo rate by 100 basis points to 37 percent, marking its first interest rate decision of 2026.

item.title: Syria says SDF exploits ISIL fight to justify existence
item.description: The Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) have consistently exploited the fight against the ISIL terrorist organization to justify their own continued existence and financing, Syria’s Interior Ministry said on Jan. 22.

item.title: Zelensky suggests 'trilateral' talks between Russia, US, Ukraine in UAE
item.description: The United Arab Emirates will host "trilateral" talks on the Ukraine war this week with Ukrainian, U.S. and Russian officials, President Volodymyr Zelensky said on Thursday.

item.title: Trump unveils Board of Peace, 'New Gaza' plans at Davos
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump unveiled his new Board of Peace at Davos on Thursday, casting himself again as a global peacemaker despite widespread scepticism over a plan that aims to rewrite the global order.

item.title: Türkiye opposes foreign intervention in Iran, Erdoğan says Pezeshkian
item.description: Türkiye has never supported foreign intervention in Iran, President Recep Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said in a phone call with his Iranian counterpart Masoud Pezeshkian on Thursday.
